768.note: height blow-up is the ORIGIN behaviour: @media(max-width:768px) .list-2__item{width:calc(32% - (var(--gap-h)*0.68))} resolves against the shrink-to-fit .list-2 inside the absolutely-positioned .loop-track, so one marquee card renders 5604.16x3074.50 and .symbol-3__sd-1 becomes 3074.5 tall

adjacency.note: footer.symbol-3 is a sibling of main inside div.box.sd-1; its top edge is flush with the bottom of main (StockBandSection .sd-331). Body background rgb(247,247,247) is never visible between them.
